```{r build_function}
# ── Per-cluster panel builder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
build_panel <- function(cl, data, panels, ion_terms, h) {

  cl_contrasts <- panels %>% filter(cluster == cl) %>% pull(contrast) %>% unique()
  cl_terms     <- ion_terms %>% filter(cluster == cl) %>% pull(Description)

  # ── Heatmap data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  heat_df <- data %>%
    filter(cluster == cl, contrast %in% cl_contrasts,
           Description %in% cl_terms) %>%
    mutate(
      sig_label      = case_when(p.adjust < 0.001 ~ "***",
                                 p.adjust < 0.01  ~ "**",
                                 p.adjust < 0.05  ~ "*",
                                 TRUE ~ ""),
      Description    = str_to_title(Description),
      contrast_label = factor(contrast_labels[contrast],
                              levels = contrast_levels)
    )

  nes_lim <- max(abs(heat_df$NES), na.rm = TRUE)

  p_heat <- ggplot(heat_df,
                   aes(x = contrast_label, y = Description, fill = NES)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), size = 30,vjust = .8,
              fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
    scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdBu", direction = -1,
                         limits = c(-nes_lim, nes_lim), name = "NES",
                        guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = h * .2, barheight = h * 1.3)
) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) str_wrap(x, width = 14), drop = TRUE) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = \(x) str_wrap(x, width = 25)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
         title = cluster_labels[cl]) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 35) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x    = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1,
                                    face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.text.y    = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",hjust = 1),
      axis.title     = element_blank(),
      panel.grid     = element_blank(),
      plot.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 40, hjust = 0.5,vjust = 0),
      legend.text    = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold"),
      legend.title   = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold")
    )

  p_heat
}
# ── Build and save one PDF per cluster ────────────────────────────────────────
cell_order <- c("VLMC-1", "tanycyte-2", "tanycyte-1",
                "ependymal-1", "ependymal-2",
                "vascular-endothelial_1", "vascular-endothelial_2",
                "vascular-pericytes")

walk(cell_order, function(cl) {

  n_terms     <- ion_terms_by_cluster %>% filter(cluster == cl) %>% nrow()
  n_contrasts <- barrier_panels %>% filter(cluster == cl) %>% pull(contrast) %>% n_distinct()

  # Scale dimensions to content
  w <- 12 + n_contrasts * 2.2
  h <- 3 + n_terms * 1.1

  panel <- build_panel(cl, glial_gsea_results, barrier_panels, ion_terms_by_cluster,h)

  ggsave(sprintf("ion-transport-%s.pdf", file_names[cl]),
         panel, width = w, height = h)
})
```

nes plots relative to other sig results
```{r}

barrier_panels_nes = barrier_panels %>% filter(!(cluster == "ependymal-2" & contrast == "effect_of_sex_young_5x"))
# --- Plotting frame --------------------------------------------------------
ion_df <- glial_gsea_results %>%
  semi_join(barrier_panels_nes, by = c("cluster", "contrast")) %>%
  left_join(ion_terms_by_cluster, by = c("cluster", "Description")) %>%
  mutate(
    is_ion         = replace_na(is_ion, FALSE),
    contrast_label = factor(contrast_labels[contrast],
                            levels = rev(unname(contrast_labels)))
  )

# --- Shared theme ----------------------------------------------------------
theme_barrier <- theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text          = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black", size = 20),
        axis.title.x       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        axis.title.y       = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
        plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0.5))

# --- Build one plot per cell type ------------------------------------------
cell_order <- c("VLMC-1", "tanycyte-2", "tanycyte-1",
                "ependymal-1", "ependymal-2",
                "vascular-endothelial_1", "vascular-endothelial_2", "vascular-pericytes")

cell_plots <- list()

for (cl in cell_order) {

  cur_df     <- filter(ion_df, cluster == cl) %>% droplevels()
  cur_bg_sig <- filter(cur_df, !is_ion, p.adjust < 0.05)
  cur_fg_sig <- filter(cur_df,  is_ion, p.adjust < 0.05)
    cell_plots[[cl]] <- ggplot(cur_df, aes(NES, contrast_label)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(data = cur_bg_sig,
                height = 0.18, width = 0, size = 0.7, alpha = 0.28, color = "grey65") +
    geom_jitter(data = cur_fg_sig,
                height = 0.18, width = 0, size = 3, alpha = 0.95,
                shape = 21, fill = "#C0392B", color = "black", stroke = 0.5) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
    labs(x = "NES", y = NULL, title = cluster_labels[cl]) +
    theme_barrier
}

# --- Combine via patchwork: 3 rows, ependymal centered --------------------
row1 <- cell_plots[["VLMC-1"]] |
        cell_plots[["tanycyte-2"]] |
        cell_plots[["tanycyte-1"]]

row2 <- plot_spacer() |
        cell_plots[["ependymal-1"]] |
        cell_plots[["ependymal-2"]] |
        plot_spacer()
row2 <- row2 + plot_layout(widths = c(0.5, 1, 1, 0.5))

row3 <- cell_plots[["vascular-endothelial_1"]] |
        cell_plots[["vascular-endothelial_2"]] |
        cell_plots[["vascular-pericytes"]]

combined <- row1 / row2 / row3

ggsave("barrier-ion-transport-nes-combined.pdf", combined,
       width = 25, height = 10)
```



```{r supplementary_function}
# ── Supplementary heatmap: all 12 contrasts for one cluster ───────────────────
# ── Supplementary heatmap: all 12 contrasts for one cluster ───────────────────
# --- Build one plot per cell type ------------------------------------------
cell_order <- c("VLMC-1", "tanycyte-1","tanycyte-2", 
                "ependymal-1", "ependymal-2",
                "vascular-endothelial_1", "vascular-endothelial_2", "vascular-pericytes")

build_supplementary_heatmap <- function(cl, data, ion_terms, h) {

  cl_terms <- ion_terms %>% filter(cluster == cl) %>% pull(Description)

  heat_df <- data %>%
    filter(cluster == cl,
           contrast %in% names(all_contrast_labels),
           Description %in% cl_terms) %>%
    mutate(
      sig_label      = case_when(p.adjust < 0.001 ~ "***",
                                 p.adjust < 0.01  ~ "**",
                                 p.adjust < 0.05  ~ "*",
                                 TRUE ~ ""),
      Description    = str_to_title(Description),
      contrast_label = factor(all_contrast_labels[contrast],
                              levels = all_contrast_levels)
    )

  nes_lim <- max(abs(heat_df$NES), na.rm = TRUE)

  ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = contrast_label, y = Description, fill = NES)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), size = 20, vjust = .8,
              fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
    scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdBu", direction = -1,
                         limits = c(-nes_lim, nes_lim), name = "NES",
                         guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = h * .2,
                                                barheight = h * 1.3)) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) str_wrap(x, width = 14), drop = TRUE) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = \(x) str_wrap(x, width = 25)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
         title = cluster_labels[cl]) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 40) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x    = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1,
                                    face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.text.y    = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black", hjust = 1),
      axis.title     = element_blank(),
      panel.grid     = element_blank(),
      plot.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 60, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0),
      legend.text    = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
      legend.title   = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold")
    )
}

# ── Save one supplementary heatmap for all
supp_plots =  map(cell_order, function(cl) {

  n_terms <- ion_terms_by_cluster %>% filter(cluster == cl) %>% nrow()

  # 12 contrasts on x-axis; height scales with term count
  h <- 3 + n_terms * 1.1

  build_supplementary_heatmap(cl, glial_gsea_results, ion_terms_by_cluster, h)
})

combined_supp <- wrap_plots(supp_plots, ncol = 2)

ggsave("combined_supp_ion.pdf",combined_supp, width = 80, height = 90, limitsize = F)
```
